# Source

Every form a link to Target can take:

- wikilink: [[Target]]
- with an alias: [[Target|the target]]
- with a heading: [[Target#Section]]
- markdown: [the note](Target.md)
- with an anchor: [Human label](Target.md#a-heading)

Things that merely look like links to it, and must not be rewritten:

- an image: ![Target](Target.png)
- an external URL that ends the same way: [ext](https://x.com/Target.md)
- a fenced mention:

```
[[Target]]
```

And a folder-prefixed link elsewhere: [x](Projects/Nested.md)
